title: Keyturn Roadside Assistance: Operator Network Restriction and Reimbursement Limits by Plan
content:
## Network restriction and reimbursement figures

Each Keyturn Roadside Assistance plan states whether only operators in the network may be used, the
calendar days allowed to submit a claim for an out-of-network callout, the ceiling on reimbursing such
a callout, and the calendar days allowed to supply documents for a reimbursement claim.

| Plan | Only network operators may be used | Days to submit a claim for an out-of-network callout | Ceiling on reimbursing an out-of-network callout (USD) | Days to supply documents for the claim |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Roadside Basic Cover | yes | 30 | 100.00 | 14 |
| Keyturn Roadside Plus Cover | yes | 30 | 175.00 | 14 |
| Keyturn Roadside Tow Cover | no | 45 | 300.00 | 21 |
| Keyturn Roadside EV Cover | yes | 45 | 300.00 | 21 |
| Keyturn Roadside Fleet Cover | no | 60 | 500.00 | 30 |
| Keyturn Roadside Concierge Cover | no | 90 | 1200.00 | 30 |

Both day figures are counted in calendar days.

### Notes on the schedule

1. The network restriction is carried by Keyturn Roadside Basic Cover, Keyturn Roadside Plus Cover
   and Keyturn Roadside EV Cover. It is not carried by Keyturn Roadside Tow Cover, Keyturn Roadside
   Fleet Cover or Keyturn Roadside Concierge Cover.
2. The submission period and the documentation period pair up as follows: 30 and 14
   calendar days on Keyturn Roadside Basic Cover and Keyturn Roadside Plus Cover, 45 and 21 on
   Keyturn Roadside Tow Cover and Keyturn Roadside EV Cover, 60 and 30 on Keyturn Roadside Fleet
   Cover, and 90 and 30 on Keyturn Roadside Concierge Cover.
3. The reimbursement ceiling stands at USD 100.00 on Keyturn Roadside Basic Cover, USD 175.00 on
   Keyturn Roadside Plus Cover, USD 300.00 on both Keyturn Roadside Tow Cover and Keyturn Roadside EV
   Cover, USD 500.00 on Keyturn Roadside Fleet Cover and USD 1200.00 on Keyturn Roadside Concierge
   Cover.
